scenario: Modelo 130 with a loss-making Q3: Example B, except that the net income to date falls to 20,000 at the end of Q3. Q3 pays nothing, and Q4 catches up through the cumulative base: 20 % of the annual net less what Q1 and Q2 paid.

modelo130.oracleRef: Theory §7.3, ed. 2: loss-making quarter example (Q3 net to date 20,000, 4,240 already paid, Q3 payable 0, the 240 credited against Q4). Q1, Q2 and Q4 figures are Example B's; Q3 expenses keep Example B's 5,700. The Q4 amount is not in the theory; it is arithmetic under AEAT, instrucciones del modelo 130, casillas 05, 07, 12, 15 and 19 (sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es, page updated 11 Sep 2026): casilla 12 floors Q3's negative casilla 07 at zero, so nothing carries into casilla 15, and Q4's 4,240 is the theory's 240 credit against the 4,480 accrued since Q3.
